findings.title: App Transport Security is disabled (NSAllowsArbitraryLoads)
findings.description: NSAllowsArbitraryLoads=true turns off App Transport Security: the app may load content over cleartext HTTP and weak TLS.

findings.title: App Transport Security exception for legacy.pathos-test.invalid
findings.description: Connections to legacy.pathos-test.invalid (subdomains: yes) are exempt from App Transport Security: NSExceptionAllowsInsecureHTTPLoads=true, NSExceptionMinimumTLSVersion=TLSv1.0.

findings.title: Custom URL scheme: pathostest://
findings.description: The app registers the custom URL scheme pathostest://. Any app can register the same scheme and receive the URLs, and any web page or app can open it with attacker-chosen parameters: validate every parameter and prefer universal links for sensitive actions.

findings.title: The app supports outdated iOS versions (MinimumOSVersion 12.0)
findings.description: iOS versions before 14 no longer receive security updates.

findings.title: The app can be debugged (get-task-allow entitlement)
findings.description: get-task-allow=true lets a debugger attach to the app; it is set in development builds and must not be in a release build.

findings.title: Development push notification environment
findings.description: aps-environment=development: the package was built with a development provisioning profile.

findings.title: Wildcard keychain access group
findings.description: The keychain access groups include a wildcard (PATHOSTEST.*): keychain items may be shared with every app of the team.
